description: A city Israel first failed to capture because of Achan's hidden sin, then destroyed by ambush once the sin was dealt with (Joshua 7-8).
family_friendly_summary: Ai was a Canaanite city that Israel attacked right after Jericho. The first attack failed because a man named Achan had disobeyed God by secretly keeping treasure from Jericho. Once that sin was dealt with, Israel captured Ai. It was a hard lesson that hidden sin hurts everyone, not just one person.
